notes.title: Wormhole City Free, Epilogue News, Steam Cloud Update
notes.content:
Excited to announce that Wormhole City will be available for free as development nears its conclusion. I hope this game brought you some enjoyment and conveys some merit to the feedback and iterations made throughout the years. From early access to post-release, your help made this experience possible. Your compassion and encouragement carried this dream far past a point that was ever imagined. If you purchased this game, please e-mail zenrokstudios@outlook.com if you would like to be featured in the closing credits for future updates and projects. Thank you everyone for your support.

     Currently, plans for expansion content must be delayed until further notice. A lot of work and progress has been made on new levels for 'Wormhole City Epilogue', but an official release date cannot be determined with confidence. The aspiration is to release levels with an episodic approach as Wormhole City continues on as a passion project. Given the overall performance and reception to this game, I hope this remorseful decision is understandable. Thank you everyone for giving more players the opportunity to amuse themselves with this digital diversion, thank you for playing it, and I hope to bring you better news again soon. Until then, Steam Cloud saves should be enabled!

notes.title: 4.21 Update, Discount Sale, Epilogue News
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27347623/9f583a18f879189c9a46f16e5bb430d95f57facf.png[/img]

[h1]
Unreal Engine Upgrade[/h1]

Proud to announce that Wormhole City has upgraded from UE 4.18.3 to UE4.21.2! Bug fixes, optimizations, altered visuals and more interactions have been added. I hope these improvements satisfy some of the feedback thus far while more content is planned for release.

[h1]Developer Discount Sale[/h1]

To celebrate this milestone, Wormhole City is now 50% off for a limited time! If you like what you see and want to support expansion and future projects from this indie developer, please share this announcement on social media!

[h1]
Wormhole City Epilogue News[/h1]
 
Being the first game development project, Wormhole City has been a tremendous learning experience with iterations that started four years ago. It is a blessing and honor to receive your support while committing to this dream.  

Unfortunately, critcal and commercial reception is at a level that any future updates need to be evaluated for Wormhole City. Considerations for  balancing ambitions, time, skills, personal health and a shoestring budget may force a new project altogether.

The hope for this update and sale is to help create Wormhole City Epilogue, a free expansion that uses third person gameplay, this year. Regretfully, due to personal and financial straits, the size and guarantee of this expansion may diminish without your help! 

Thank you all for your time and support throughout the years. Stay tuned for more news and hope you all have a great weekend.

[h1]Thank you. [/h1]

notes.title: Wormhole City Epilogue News and Updates
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27347623/b3d605e213cef84695246b3c3a83146321055474.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Upcoming Updates[/b][/h1]

Thank you everyone for the wonderful support throughout the ages! New content is being prepared for 2019 and I hope it shows improvements appropriate to your feedback.  

In the meantime, an upcoming patch will update Wormhole City from Unreal Engine version 4.18.3 to 4.21.2; along with improved optimizations and bug fixes, mouse hit under cursor is now much smoother and responsive for top down combat. This patch will also modify a few visual and gameplay aspects and is scheduled to be released very soon!

[h1][b]Wormhole City Epilogue Expansion[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27347623/e52e18069f2ffa86769b1df4c328f4412917b468.jpg[/img]

Wormhole City Epilogue takes place years into the future with a full third person experience and new levels of mecha-pilot combat. Investigate destructive ruins, interact with opposing forces and experience the bittersweet conclusion to this scifi episode!

While mecha combat keeps familiar run-and-gun features, on foot pilot levels will be slower paced with over-the-shoulder shooting and new environments to explore. The pilot interface uses a non-traditional hud displayed by your character to show health, munitions, and upgrades along with advice for your missions.

There is still a lot of work to be done, so expect this expansion to release by October at the earliest with our engine upgrade patch coming before that! Thank you all for supporting this game and I hope you have a healthy and prosperous 2019.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27347623/dc00c48f7a4b35c1cd2fe545075d37abcf7d1a31.png[/img]

Thank you for your time and patience.

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.1 - Hotfix
notes.content:
This update hotfixes a black screen issue with later levels in the game, thank you all for such a kind reception for our release! Please keep letting us know what you think and what you would want in future levels of the game!

We'll continue working on Wormhole City as we develop longer, third-person combat levels to be released this year. Thank you for your time.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27347623/dd4330c4f2466e3db58151db5744dac9d27bea4d.png[/img]

notes.title: Wormhole City Release and Future Updates
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27347623/64fcdc05edb1a8f3d2c985b18eaaad695d86762e.png[/img]


[h1]Wormhole City Released![/h1]
Thank you all for the incredible patience and support throughout our years of learning and development. We're excited to announce that Wormhole City is now officially released! It's been a rocky three years while hoping our work can merit the compassion you have given us, but we believe this entry is a solid foundation with room for more gameplay and stories in the future!

[h1]What happens now?[/h1]
We'll keep patching existing content while long term plans focus on new mech-environment levels taking place after Wormhole City. These levels will have third person gameplay as enemies and allies gain more complexity in ground and air battles. We hope to keep adding quality of life improvements to our gameplay options and menu systems to allow players more control of how combat feels.

[h1]Basic Wormhole City Controls[/h1]
WASD movement
Press E to interact with dialogue options
Left Mouse and Left Mouse Click to aim and shoot
LSHIFT to dash or ascend in combat and flight scenarios
LCTRL to descend in flight mode

Save file is saved in folder location:
C:\Users\[USER]\AppData\Local\AdvKitExamples\Saved\

[h1]Known Bugs and Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]The game may not start until it is approved by your anti-virus software.
[*]Using Alt + F4 or Task Manager to close Wormhole City may affect your save file.
[*]Software tools like Windows Magnify Glass may override mouse cursor functions.
[/list]
Thank you all for this opportunity to make a passion come true. We hope everyone will have a healthy and prosperous 2019, stay tuned for more of us next year! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27347623/9971d9a6c713027c2fb8761d82e145091e4bd037.png[/img]

notes.title: Wormhole City Breakdown and Dev Log for Update 1.01.14
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27347623/6c5e31e765d5df2dd3f841e1add56c246c583c27.png[/img]

[h1] [b]Developer Notes[/b] [/h1] 

Hello everyone and thank you for your continued patience and support while Wormhole City's game development carries on. I hope to reciprocate all of the passion that has been given to this project by the amazing people who send their feedback as tough decisions will need to be made this year.

To preface and help understand the decision-making needed to be made, Zenrok Studios, when it comes to the development of Wormhole City, is a one-man effort that utilizes assets from different degrees of licenses to help lower production costs in making games. The aim of this approach, along with the release on Steam Early Access, was to gauge the interest players might have for making Wormhole City a full-time project.

Unfortunately this plan and our game's performance resulted in alarming results while life's obligations has strained development time. The responsibility of Wormhole City's delivery in its ambitions were met by shortcomings that were not prepared for this first entry  into  the video game medium.

With these circumstances in mind, the current plan is to iterate, add, and complete as much as possible and officially release Wormhole City in December 2018. Content and support is planned to continue after release until personal standards feels achieved. The pace of these plans and updates will hopefully show progress and programming improvements within the contents of Wormhole City as this update releases this year.

https://youtu.be/fL-Po-OukKs

[h1] [b]Changes[/b] [/h1] 

General Optimizations
Proud to say individual acts now fully incorporate level streaming. This should substantially decrease load times as alternatives seem to take longer. Extensive coding and levels changes have been made to help this effort as more menu option essentials are put in place.  

Initial levels in the game now include more audio-visual cues and interactions, Improved user interface and HUD to Act 1 will show more events to encounter in each level. Levels had been expanded on to help give more clues into the story and the main character's conflicts.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27347623/e7c6c6cc7211d52a34e746a1f243b62be2e6ab90.png[/img]

Desert Hovercraft vehicle changed

Replaced previous vehicle in this level with a hover bike with improved controls and collision detection for current and any future driving segments. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27347623/e9e380e17e4054e07e998e1c984016d40d7bd318.png[/img]

Air/Space vehicle replaced with mech flying 

There were many critiques with this flight level and to hopefully alleviate the aggravation players experienced,  the space vehicle in this section has been replaced with flying mech  gameplay, you are now able to fly or run using your mech with controls that should feel better than before. The space vehicle may return.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27347623/3e7ee883abc50d3a843073fbb4b68afb23254d51.png[/img]


[h1] [b]Act 2[/b] [/h1] 


This new addition to the story takes place a few days after the events of Act 1 where Acero Astra combats the mental aftermath and fatigue from conflicts for power and control in space. Wormhole City Act 2 will include 3 extensive combat scenarios that take place in Urban, Water, and Space environments. 

The biggest gameplay change in Act 2 will be the camera and aiming controls for mech levels. With flying mechanics now involved, it became difficult to create a functional method to combat enemies above the player character.  I hope this new gameplay style will exceed any enjoyment experienced from previous levels. Shifting camera angles will still be used for segments throughout the game. The plan is to add more weapons and functions that focus on mech combat as this project comes to conclusion.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27347623/820360b4696ab9e77508b717bb3a5e1e555ecf0b.png[/img]

[h1] [b]Wormhole City's Future[/b] [/h1] 

Plans for Act 3's content will likely leave an opportunity for new stories in any future installments made to this universe. The hope is that most of this work can be extended from its gameplay, music, sound effects, voice acting, and one day multiplayer. 

Thank you everyone and I hope the news for this upcoming update may give some optimism and excitement for Wormhole City's future. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27347623/aed93c0eb44bd0195999410e72abbf61ad828ccc.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.01.13, Updated Engine, Act 2 News and Dev Notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Excited to announce we have updated our game from Unreal Engine 4.10.4 to version 4.18.1, this is a small milestone for our project as it allows us to utilize over two years worth of updates to the Unreal Engine. We hope this may solve some start-up and optimization issues players have been having throughout our development as we prepare to release Act 2 content in the last days of December. While progress on Wormhole City Act 2 has been turbulent and plagued with dead SSD drives and personal obstacles, we hope you enjoy what we have of the content we release before the new year. If you would like to take a closer look at our development please don't hesitate to talk with us through [url=https://www.twitch.tv/allenspectrum]Twitch[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/zenrok_studios]Twitter[/url]. Thank you all so much and we'll get back to grinding!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27347623/d2fdc57b0b5dfdb4c79d002ddac1100bc64bcd46.png[/img]

notes.title: Wormhole City Act 2, Upcoming Patch and Devlog Details
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27347623/2ccf098703c96591052280e71bd211e0ba343f97.png[/img]

Thank you everyone for your tremendous patience and support as we continue development on Wormhole City. We're excited to announce new content that will be released before this year is over as well as updates and patch notes that are planned to arrive before June is finished.

[b]Story[/b]:
https://youtu.be/kQSzzEvpof4
Wormhole City Act 2 continues the story of Acero Astra and the struggle for survival when a lucrative bounty is declared on the pilot by outlaw factions.  Experience two sides of the conflict in Act 2 by controlling Astra and outlaw Marko in the ongoing strife for control and freedom. We plan to release the Act 2 update with new items, enemies, and levels before the end of this year. 


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27347623/35a3adda36cb351475ed36901f823da5c72f2063.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27347623/19efc3c48059ecdb7853c5706e7643cdb70ad6a7.png[/img]

[b]Gameplay[/b]:

Two significant gameplay mechanics will be modified and added to current and future content releases. The aiming mechanics for pilot and robot gameplay has been changed to give you multi-directional range of attack from different heighths using your mouse cursor. This top-down style of aiming and movement will only activate with certain equipment and key presses. 

The second feature arriving soon is the minimap to help players navigate levels, investigate distress signals and other points of interest. Unless you come across certain information during a level, the minimap may not show all the obstacles coming your way or the location of helpful equipment and allies in obscure locations.  

Other top-down staples have been implemented such as walls that fade when blocking the player's view of the character, improved enemy AI with more variety in behaviors, NPC companions, new skills, environments, puzzles, combat scenarios and overall number of interactive objects will continue to be added to current and future content for Wormhole City. 


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27347623/08cfd888c7a2993450da831c0a3607d0a564fd9e.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27347623/7239b58e44b95e1cee15002332732a83df73f440.png[/img]

[b]Patch Notes Preview[/b]:

We plan to release a patch for Wormhole City before June is over to address optimization issues and to begin adding more content. Some of the changes will include:

[list]
[*]Minimap will be implemented.

[*]Additional interactive objects and characters.

[*]More voice, audio, and visual effects will be included.

[*]Adding more content and revising the design of specific levels.

[*]Improved hit and trace detection with space combat.

[*]Hopefully reduce game crashing and problems with keyboard inputs.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27347623/105d59856f8f0499101ce87563b020962ca2d608.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27347623/1cc2f6d771a26a098c05ac7aa2b6586c48c80582.png[/img]

[b]Dev Log[/b]:

We will be releasing an in-depth devlog and game project details in the near future.

Working on implementing a 'Space Academy' tutorial level that will help players with vehicle controls beforehand.

Developing more enemy behaviors and 'boss' mechanics.

Will be replacing the hover vehicle in the Desert level.

Planning on all levels to be lengthened and polished as new updates release.

We still undergoing the process of finding a programmer with specialties in optimizations in Unreal Engine 4. Our plan is to make our game as compatible as we can for different operating systems and configurations. 

There is still a tremendous amount of work to do and thank you all for taking the time to give us your thoughts, feedback and support during this arduous period of development. 

[b]New Patch Will Be Released Before June 30th; Stay Tuned![/b]

https://youtu.be/rsbcxqK1m_o

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27347623/e3b45f57491e1411cb5faae5ec16154fdc51edfa.png[/img]
